seats.mission: Resolver scout: read reports/round-43/op/O09-scribe.md:356-870 (the fenced 515-line successor body) and tools/harness/couples-reference-extractor.py end-to-end. Produce the precise landing spec: which defects the O09 body fixes vs the live extractor (blank-line continue->break, glob-precedence, ambiguous/indented-prose controls, four-class census, disposition leg), the exact target path, and how couples-reference-extractor.py is demoted to witness-only without editing its bytes.

Gap scout: run a FRESH absence sweep at the 223 total across all six partitions. Name ONE genuinely unowned gap (verify no entry owns it — topic-line + filename sweep at HEAD c9f4eaa, not carried from any prior round). Recommend the partition + the entry's topic + its source shelf. Report the sweep commands and their outputs.

Freshness-gate scout: read reports/round-43/review/R01-review.md R01-43-12 and reports/round-43/claims.json. Specify what a pre-dispatch claims-freshness check must re-derive (each claim's `before` against the close commit) and the minimum pass/fail contract. Survey whether any existing tools/harness/ script already does this (none should).
Plans for all three claims: O's landing + witness-demotion + census artifact, C's scout->draft->audit->land sequence, Ca's freshness-gate build + r43 regression demonstration.
Cross-claim connector: how O's census artifact denominator (223 vs 224) orders against C's landing; how Ca's freshness gate would have caught r43's O and C; the single census artifact name.

Landing spec author: extract the exact fenced body from op/O09-scribe.md:356-870, verify its sha256 is 43ce341f…, and produce the integrator's apply instructions (target path tools/harness/basename-couples-resolver.py, byte-exact, no modification). Note any header/path adjustment the body's own docstring sanctions.

Independent verifier 1: byte-extract the O09 body to a clean .scratch dir (no corpus shadow above it), run --selftest and --census there, and confirm 27/27 + the four-class 2556+166+0+7=2729 +1 glob. Confirm the wrapped field reads 4/4 by identity not arity.

Independent verifier 2: confirm the O09 body fixes the live extractor's defects — couples_block break-at-blank-line, glob-fragment precedence over ambiguous, ambiguous + indented-prose controls present, four-class + disposition leg present. Report each as fixed/absent with line refs.

Witness-demotion spec: how couples-reference-extractor.py is labelled regression-witness (N6 witness) without editing its bytes — a README/LOG/instrument-index note and the O07 parity-receipt shape recording both runs, differences explained solely by subclass separation.

Trap verifier: hunt the residual traps in the O09 body — a token with a :NN anchor, brace expansion, a basename matching two files, a couples field as the last header line, the hyphen-heal edge. Confirm the body's class assignment for each is the policy's.

Census-artifact author: the exact calib/couples-census JSON the integrator files — four-class totals 2556+166+0+7=2729 +1 quarantined glob, the 50 distinct fallback mappings, the 7 unresolved rows with reasons, conservation identity, baseline_commit + entries header.

Parity-receipt author/verifier: run both tools' census (basename-couples-resolver from .scratch, couples-reference-extractor read-only) and produce the parity receipt — same 223/2730 input, differences explained solely by the documented four-class-vs-six-class subclass separation.

Negative-proof: confirm landing O09's body writes only tools/harness/basename-couples-resolver.py + reports/round-44/**, edits no filed byte (r42 extractor digest d8d23a26… stays), no corpus write, no second competing resolver path.

O-claim scribe: assemble the claim-O evidence chain — landing spec + two verifiers + defects-verify + witness-demotion + census artifact + parity + negative-proof — into the integration-ready summary.

Census-arithmetic verifier: independently recompute the four-class fold from the O09 body's --census output (2556+166+0+7=2729 +1 glob = 2730); confirm zero tokens dropped and policy §5.6's glob exclusion is honored; confirm the census artifact's conservation identity.

Second gap scout (independent of K02): run your own fresh absence sweep at 223 and either confirm K02's named gap is unowned or name a different unowned gap; corroborate the one-owner-per-topic precondition before any landing.

Entry drafter: given K02's verified-unowned gap, draft the new corpus entry under the partition's naming + established entry contract (header fields, - couples:, - sources:, calibration, recheck, scope). Draft as a fenced block for integrator application — never stage under corpus/ directly.

README rev 2.5 draft: the exact README.md edits — new row in filename order, totals 223->224, footer dir_totals, a revision header noting the r44 landing — as a fenced diff. Note the pre-existing rev-2.4 prose-vector defect (sums 217 not 223) for repair in the same edit if touched.
Source audit: audit C01's draft — every backticked in-repo path resolves at HEAD c9f4eaa, every cited line number is real, no fabricated source. Report each citation's verify status.

Contract audit: the draft satisfies corpus/QUALITY.md (calibration present, living-practice flags, no canon claim, handoff target named) and the partition naming/structure convention; the gap is genuinely unowned per K02's fresh sweep. Report pass/fail per clause.
Collision verifier: independently enumerate the target partition at HEAD, confirm the proposed filename is unused AND the topic is unowned (no second owner), confirm landing changes no other file.
C-claim scribe: assemble the claim-C evidence — gap scout + draft + README + two audits + collision verify — into the integration-ready summary.

Freshness-gate author: build the durable pre-dispatch claims-freshness check (tools/harness/claims-freshness.py or a documented gate) that re-derives each claim's `before` against the close commit and flags a `before` already false. Freshness verifier: independently run Ca01's gate over the r43 claims (positive regression: flags O and C) and over a true-`before` claim (negative control: does not flag). Confirm it is durable not .scratch.

Non-author reviewer: review the whole round's evidence — O's successor landing + census + witness-demotion, C's fresh-gap landing + README, Ca's freshness gate. Named-verifier judgment per claim: improved/harmed/unchanged/unprovable-but-better, each with the evidence read.

Second non-author reviewer: independent read of the three claims' landed evidence. Focus on whether any axis is harmed (does the successor fork or shadow the r42 extractor? does C land a duplicate or overwrite? does the freshness gate actually catch a stale before?). Per-axis verdict + named findings.

Trades critic: hunt any trade — the successor landing shadowing the r42 extractor into two authorities; C landing a verified-unowned gap that turns out owned; the freshness gate being theater (can't actually detect a stale before). Report each suspected trade with evidence.

Honesty critic: check every claimed number is measured not asserted (27/27, the four-class census, the +1 coverage, the freshness gate's flag). Flag any 'should work' wording. Verify no seat wrote outside its out path and nothing staged under corpus/.
Integration scribe: assemble the whole round — all three claims' evidence chains, the per-axis verdict candidates, the SHONEN section — into the integration draft the parent uses to land + judge.
Telemetry scribe: draft the observed-dispatch + availability-close-44 skeletons (owner, window, counting commands, durable source paths + sha256 placeholders the integrator fills).

Bleed/scope verifier: confirm no cross-domain bleed (no canon, no lore decision, no packet surface), PROVINCE.md still accurate, and the only corpus delta is the single C landing + README. Report any scope violation.
